headline: US Official Confirms Strikes on Iranian Targets in Strait of Hormuz
summary: A US official confirmed limited strikes on Iranian targets in the Strait of Hormuz on the eve of American midterm elections, avoiding a full return to hostilities.
why: The Strait of Hormuz is a critical global chokepoint for petroleum transit, making any military escalation in the region vital for energy markets and geopolitical risk assessments.
why_moved: Geopolitical military actions in a major oil transit chokepoint instantly raise supply disruption premiums in energy markets.
